Dessine la courbe du réglage au doigt (o: Draw the setting's curve with your finger (or a line in two taps): it moves by itself during the song. Every curve is also in the Mixer.
Une valeur par temps (¼ de mesure) sur t: One value per beat (¼ bar) over the whole song (%d bars); it glides from point to point.
Piste gelée : « Dégeler » pour modifier: Frozen track: “Unfreeze” to change its notes.
Arrête d'abord l'enregistrement pour cha: Stop recording first to change the chords.
Pour geler une piste, il faut un morceau: To freeze a track you need a song: add your parts in the Song tab.
Les huit pistes audio sont prises : libè: All eight audio tracks are in use: free one to freeze this track.
Morceau trop long pour geler une piste (: Song too long to freeze a track (%d minutes at most).
%d réglages bougent déjà : retires-en un: %d settings already move: remove one in the Mixer to automate another.
Polyrythme : ce pad repart tous les %d p: Polyrhythm: this pad restarts every %d steps, the others every %d.
Tonalité : %s. Les pistes qui suivent ch: Key: %s. The tracks that follow change with the chords, in every part.
Tu écoutes les nouveaux accords. « Appli: You're hearing the new chords. “Apply” keeps them (one undo step), “Cancel” brings back the old ones.
Touche une progression : tu l'entends to: Tap a progression: you hear it right away, over the whole song, before applying it.
Partie par partie (une case = une mesure: Part by part (one box = one bar)
Les pistes de l'assistant suivent ; les: The assistant's tracks follow; notes you wrote stay as they are unless you ask here.
Touche pour changer les accords de tout: Tap to change the chords of the whole song.
Piste gelée : elle joue son rendu audio: Frozen track: it plays its audio render in the song. “Unfreeze” (track menu) to change its notes.
Touche une case : ajoute une note. Touch: Tap a cell: adds a note. Tap a note: selects it. Long press: removes it. Drag: moves, the end: lengthens. Numbers on top: a whole bar. Bottom lane: drag to set the velocity.
